terra.problem: The line places Hagar’s meeting with God in Shur. Genesis 16:7 says the spring was on the road to Shur, not necessarily in Shur.
“Abraham settles near Shur” overstates the location. Genesis 20:1 says he settled between Kadesh and Shur and stayed in Gerar; it does not say he settled at or near Shur.

“After Ishmael died, his descendants settled” implies that they settled there only after his death. Genesis 25:17–18 reports his death before describing where they settled, but it does not establish that timing.
